purpose: Classify newly confirmed local/publicly staged hydrogen-station candidates without promoting partial or simulated data to full-loop validation.

required_for_full_loop_holdout: receiving vessel or vehicle pressure and temperature
delivered mass or attested mass flow
one common time base with units and initial conditions
controller, protocol, or explicit boundary mapping
documented reuse rights and custodian attestation

eligible_use: compressor, valve and ESD state screening
ineligible_use: vehicle SOC or receiving-vessel thermal validation
candidates.claim_limit: The collection is quantitatively substantial, but the vehicle/dispenser semantic boundary is not attested in the screened exports.

candidates.evidence_class: public measured tank and hose boundary
candidates.reuse_rights: package licence requires permission before redistribution of the raw workbook
eligible_use: future frozen component holdout after protocol freeze
candidates.claim_limit: The frozen pressure screen failed and the package has no station-controller, ESD, cascade, receptacle or protocol trace; geometry sensitivity remains exploratory and cannot change the default model.

candidates.evidence_class: public Modelica simulator and protocol reference
candidates.claim_limit: Modelica outputs are generated model results; no measured station-to-vehicle logger trace was found in the package.

coverage_assessment.main_limit: The local collection is rich for station-side dynamics and the staged public package adds tank-boundary evidence, but no independently attested synchronized station-to-vehicle cohort with controller/protocol channels was identified.

next_action: Keep the local station-side and NREL tank-boundary evidence in their bounded roles; request a custodian-approved de-identified station-to-vehicle logger cohort before claiming full-loop external validation.
